areas.summary: Limited publicly visible evidence for curriculum (2 specific items). Listed provision includes spoken language in both english.

signals.text: All pupils, including those who are disadvantaged and those who have special educational needs and/or disabilities, build secure knowledge across reading, writing and spoken language in both English and Welsh.
The school's effective teaching of early reading, writing and spoken language ensure that pupils can develop the skills they need to become fluent in both English and Welsh.

areas.summary: Strong publicly visible evidence for enrichment and extra-curricular activity (6 specific items). Listed provision includes art club, art, practise cooking, after school club, wrap around care.

signals.text: Pupils are encouraged to participate in clubs, trips, festivals, and community events which support their social, emotional, and cultural growth.
For example, pupils benefit from learning French, practise cooking and express themselves creatively in art club.
Needs attention Despite the school's small size, it offers a range of clubs and activities to further broaden pupils' talents and interests.
For example, pupils take part in the annual youth festival in Wales, regularly attend a Welsh church in London and join in with St.
Wrap Around Care / After School Clubs The school also provides wrap around care.
